name: TRAIN CONDUCTOR v0.3 - FPS Platformer
author: WandererStudio
description:
We are happy to release v0.3 of this prototype!
- 4 new maps.
- New mechanics
- New Menu
- New HUD
- More VFX and SFX on both enemy and player
- Balancing old mechanic to make it more enjoyable

TRAIN CONDUCTOR is a hardcore first-person platformer come with lightning fast action, set in a dusty punk-realm. Jump, slide, dash and slash your way to the very end door!

The game is still in development. This is only a Prototype to show you the feel of what we want to present in the future. Please tune in for more update.

Controls:

MOVEMENT: [WASD]
JUMP: [Space]
DASH: [Left Shift]
CROUCH: [Left Control] or [C]
SLIDE: Run a bit then Crouch
INTERACT: Press [E] to interact with key and door
ATTACK: [LMB] (Left Mouse Button)
SLOW TIME: [Q]
Gameplay:

Your mission is to collect three keys in order to unlock the path lead to final escape door. Feel free to kill everything on your path.

p/s: it's not really set in a train anymore but we haven't found a new name for it so...
